supporting_observations.claim: At 13:42 UTC, tess.hart created guest.rwong. The creation event's logon ID matches a preceding successful network logon for tess.hart to DC-ORC-01 from WS-THART-01.

The account name follows the documented guest.<name> temporary-account convention, and the next account-management event adds guest.rwong to Volunteers. This is consistent with the stated help-desk account-creation practice.
The supplied account-management records show the Volunteers group addition; they do not show guest.rwong being added to an administrator group.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied records do not provide a complete account-group membership snapshot or all subsequent activity for guest.rwong.
The logs do not establish who requested the account or whether the request was approved.
claims_not_established: Whether rwong is the intended account holder and the account was requested for a legitimate purpose.
Whether guest.rwong had any additional group memberships or permissions not represented in the supplied records.
Whether guest.rwong was used after creation.
additional_evidence_needed: For independent account validation, check the help-desk request or approval and the current account group memberships.
unrelated_findings: Tess.hart's workstation launched Google Drive File Stream, which is not among the listed approved cloud-storage services. This is separate from the account-creation alert. (T288-00016, T288-00018)

Tess.hart initiated RDP to DC-ORC-01 and received a successful remote-interactive logon there, despite the stated practice that remote administration is done only from WS-SBYRNE-01. (T288-00023, T288-00025, T288-00026)

Tess.hart later initiated RDP to FILE-ORC-01 and received a successful remote-interactive logon there, also outside the stated remote-administration practice. The supplied records show these sessions as tess.hart, not guest.rwong. (T288-00072, T288-00077, T288-00078)
